summary: Verification run: authentication code path is fully healthy in the PREVIEW environment. All 5 backend auth tests passed (login owner, wrong-pw 401, register+login+logout, session persistence). Full UI flow on /login also passed: wrong password shows 'Invalid email or password' and stays on /login, correct owner login redirects to /dashboard with sidebar+credits (∞), page reload keeps session, sidebar 'Log out' works, and /dashboard redirects to /login after logout. This confirms the production sign-in failure at https://sitegenie.dev is infrastructure (Atlas unreachable), not application code.
critical_code_review_comments: Auth code is clean: httpOnly session_token cookie set on login/register, /api/auth/me works with cookie, logout invalidates session, protected routes correctly redirect to /login when unauthenticated.

Production issue is Atlas MongoDB connectivity (as diagnosed by main agent): non-DB endpoints (e.g. /api/plans) return 200; DB-backed endpoints time out and 500 after ~8s serverSelectionTimeoutMS. Fix belongs at infra layer (Atlas IP allowlist / SRV DNS / credentials for prod env), not code.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth path in preview is 100% healthy. Do NOT test https://sitegenie.dev — production Atlas is the known infra issue. Owner login on preview shows dashboard with 'CREDITS ∞' and 'Hi, Owner 👋' — good sanity marker. Sidebar 'Log out' has data-testid containing 'logout'. Wrong-password error uses data-testid='login-error'. Rate limit exists (429 after several rapid failed logins) — space out negative tests or randomize email.
rca of the issue: Not a code bug. Production DB (MongoDB Atlas) is unreachable from the sitegenie.dev deployment, causing all DB-backed routes (login, market, blog) to hit the 8s serverSelectionTimeoutMS and return 500. Non-DB routes (/api/plans) still return 200 because they don't touch the DB. In preview, DB is reachable and all auth flows succeed end-to-end (backend + UI verified). Mitigation: fix Atlas connectivity from production — verify (1) MONGO_URL/DB_NAME env vars are set correctly in prod, (2) Atlas Network Access allowlist includes the production egress IPs (or 0.0.0.0/0 for serverless), (3) SRV DNS resolves, (4) Atlas user credentials are valid and have readWrite on DB_NAME.
